Battle4Tickets was a one day 2on2 tournament organized by {{player|Zalon|flag=dk}}. What made this tournament special was that only people who were going to attend [[QHLAN 14]] were allowed to participate and that the winners would get a free entry to the event.

}}== Highlights ==
* {{player|Xenic|flag=fi}} & {{player|Ihminen|flag=fi}} vs. {{player|bps|flag=se}} & {{player|mawe|flag=se}} on [[ztndm3]]: Even though Ihminen was lagged out for most of the game, xenic ruled the map alone for the first couple of minutes. Eventually, bps & mawe of course got too overwhelming. [http://qhlan.quakeworld.nu/?sid=2&mod=matches&act=view_match&opt=80]
* {{player|ParadokS|flag=dk}} & {{player|XantoM|flag=se}} vs. {{player|Valla|flag=se}} & {{player|Rikoll|flag=no}} on [[dm6]] in the grand finals: One of the most epic comebacks ever by [[XantoM]] and [[ParadokS]].

== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[aerowalk]], [[ztndm3]]
* Ruleset: Smackdown, no rocket jumping scripts
* Time limit: 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* Powerups ON (OFF @ DM4 & DM6)
* Discharges enabled
